kernel.integration_rule: One designated integrator serially reviews/composes exports, catalog and UI/runtime. Domain adapters cannot change kernel files or each others files. Shared contract/domain migrations remain owned by their actual producers; integrator consumes them, never duplicates SQL.
kernel.boundary: No package owns packages/evry/, packages/contracts/, application feature roots or all evaluation files wholesale.

adapter_packages.closure_gate: Actual native/domain adapter parity and registered denial/correction/replay fixtures pass; register Person consumer before package closure if any PersonId reference is introduced.

shared_domain_rule: Each native action and assistant adapter invokes the same authorized owning domain function. Only domain owner owns mutation/history/revision/receipt/audit/effect intent transaction.

WP-046 actual published summary producer before WP-047
WP-015 Person registration protocol then each later consumer
no_new_framework: Static typed manifests plus one composition function. No plugin bus, general policy/workflow engine, source-helper service factory or generic coding agent.
